title: The reading room
starting_code:
# This program works, but it writes the same number three times.
# Give the number a name.
wizard.move_right(3)
wizard.move_up(3)
wizard.move_right(3)
hints: Give the number `3` a name like `steps` at the top of your program.
Use the `=` sign to put the value under the name.
Use your new name inside the brackets instead of the number.
intro: Welcome to the library, {wizard}. To reach my desk, new pupils often write this little program, but it repeats itself. Let us make it neater.
outro: Much better! A tidy program is a joy to read.
learned: Now you know what a variable is, and how a name for a value keeps a program tidy.
